summary: A bundle of top-level media and graph changes improves stability, privacy, and AudioWorklet support: MediaTrackGraph shutdown and thread invariants were hardened to avoid stranded messages and race conditions, rebasing clocks now preserves unplayed audio, and a macOS seek-queue delay freeze was fixed so long seeks won’t hang playback. Privacy work includes spoofing PiP sizes when under RFP (resists fingerprinting) and there are fixes for MediaRecorder/MediaEncoder blob promise races and picture-region conversions. AudioWorklet message passing is now natively supported in the graph, improving real-time audio messaging reliability.
